title: Solidity Syntax and Contract Structure
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Solidity Syntax and Contract Structure and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 3: Solidity Syntax and Contract Structure; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 3 roadmap: Basic Structure of a Solidity Program; SPDX License Identifiers; The pragma solidity Directive; Declaring a Contract; Naming Conventions and Code Formatting; Writing Comments in Solidity; Single-Line and Multi-Line Comments; NatSpec Documentation Comments; Declaring State Variables; Declaring Functions; Understanding Constructors; Understanding Contract Deployment; Common Syntax Errors and Compiler Diagnostics. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
